description: This Kotlin file defines a test utility class `TestNetworkMonitor` implementing the `NetworkMonitor` interface. It provides a mock network connectivity monitor for testing purposes, allowing tests to manually set network connectivity states.

classes.name: TestNetworkMonitor
classes.description: A test implementation of `NetworkMonitor` that uses a `MutableStateFlow` to simulate network connectivity changes.

methods.name: setConnected
methods.description: Sets the connectivity state for testing purposes by updating the `connectivityFlow`'s value.
